Both were revised, 02-sai / no_selling_self 5 -> 4, with the same 'to' in both responses. There are still no enterprises and no foreign code, so 4, not lower. Final owner_fit scores: 01 4/4, 02 4/4, 03 2/3, 04 2/1. The decision rests on the quoted source text, not on the reviewers' count.
